A fresh fixed fixture compiles to its declared G000001, barrier routing withholds that PIN until RELEASE, RELEASE preserves the same fixed generation, timeout attempts no PIN, incomplete fixed evidence remains FIXED_GENERATION_RECONCILE attention without G+1, the 4-collision threshold resolves attention, and ordinary retry-safe recovery still advances to G+1. No live fixture window, production /w, Current, Served or Human Accepted authority was created.
